Card Q&A.q: Does this card's inherited effect also trigger when one of my opponent's effects plays my Digimon?

Effect: [On Play] By trashing 1 card in your hand, you may return 1 Digimon card with the [Dark Animal] or [Shaman] trait from your trash to the hand.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an effect plays one of your Digimon, gain 1 memory.
